The research was conducted in both private and public schools in Brazil, with participants from ethnically diverse backgrounds.

1._section_summary: This section presents descriptive statistics for a single study with 347 participants (171 male, 176 female) aged approximately 11 years, including measures of age, weight, height, BMI, body image estimation, dissatisfaction, and Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) scores. The text reports psychometric properties of the BAS and concurrent validity evidence, showing a negative correlation between BAS scores and BMI for the overall sample (r = –.230, p < .001) and the female group (r = –.338, p < .001), indicating that higher body appreciation is associated with lower BMI.
